next.reason: 1985: 'The same symbolic-character-1 must appear only once in a SYMBOLIC CHARACTERS clause.' 2023 §2023:12.3.7.3 SR16 a) widens the wording to 'only once within the SYMBOLIC CHARACTER clauses of this SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph', but 1985 already refused a repeat across clauses: symbolic-characters form a disjoint set of user-defined words and §1985:IV.4.2.2.1.1 says 'all user-defined words within a given disjoint set must be unique' (a symbolic-character cannot be qualified). The same programs are refused.
